reciprocal_competition_scope: entire sample assembly; never treat a contig as an independent genome
complete_orf_definition: partial=00; unambiguous in-frame CDS; valid table-11 start and terminal stop; no internal stop; translated peptide equals prediction
partial_translation: Do not force initial methionine at a partial start (start_type=Edge). Preserve partial bits verbatim without inventing 5prime/3prime labels.
module_membership: unambiguous bidirectional homolog or sole exact seed peptide; separately report complete and partial ORFs; comparators excluded
tblastn_hsp_limit: unset: retain all HSPs returned by BLAST
tblastn_target_limit: max(1, number of assembly contigs); no lower reporting cap
tblastn_summary: query-coordinate union per seed,contig,strand; descriptive only; never stitch HSPs into an ORF
tblastn_subject_coverage: not applicable to whole contig; protein 90-percent subject coverage is applied only to predicted proteins
